task_description: Enhance existing Medical Insurance Cost Prediction ML project into a full-stack application: fix the FastAPI backend (broken paths, no validation, orphaned files), build a React/Vite dashboard with 5 pages (Overview, Predict, Evaluation, Explainability, Fairness), add pytest test suite, and rewrite the README. Uses existing model/model.pkl (RandomForestRegressor) without retraining.
